text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Done with our shopping, Super Creek<n>and I are
heading toward the station<n>when we see a crowd
gathered in<n>front of a giant screen.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume Popularity Contest?<n>That sounds like
quite an interesting<n>show!

text_block_list.name: Popular Star
text_block_list.text:
I just know Oguri Cap will be the<n>winner! She's got
overwhelming<n>strength and her rivals don't even
faze her!

text_block_list.name: Popular Comedian
text_block_list.text:
And Super Creek is right up there<n>with her! No
doubt in my mind, the<n>popularity polls are going to
be split<n>right down the middle during the next<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
They both have a lot of fans, that's<n>for sure! Sales
of their plushies and<n>other merchandise are
neck-to-neck<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm... dreaming, Trainer. I<n>never thought
there'd come a day<n>when so many people would
cheer<n>for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All these races I've been through<n>with you, and all
my running<n>alongside the others... So much has
happened...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen served as a huge<n>turning point for
Super Creek. As for<n>the next goal she should set
her<n>sights on...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What should you do? Sounds to melike you've done plenty! Everyone'shollerin' about Creek 'n' Oguri dis,Creek 'n' Oguri dat!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam! You're not... upset, are you?

Course I am! The whole world's got<n>eyes for the
two of you and nobody<n>else! What am I, chopped
carrots?!
But you're the one at the top of myhit list! I'm workin' my tail off, butyou seem fine just pitter-patterin'down the road. You run outta gas or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya might think this's over, but I'm<n>just gettin'
started... Watch your<n>back, or else White
Lightning'll flash<n>right past ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm leavin'! Later!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Bye, Tamtam! Watch out for cars on<n>your way
back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Craaash!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taken aback by Super Creek's<n>unwaveringly
maternal response to<n>her challenge, Tamamo Cross
trips<n>over herself. Super Creek and I help<n>her up
before continuing on our way.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Isn't that Inari over there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, now we're talkin'! Business<n>is boomin'
for Inari One's Special<n>Express Delivery Service!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Will you really be all right carrying all<n>that on your
own?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry 'bout it! I'll just think of<n>it as trainin'.
Hell, add a few more to<n>the pile!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We all gotta do our parts if we wanna<n>take down
the big baddie.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Inari too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I'm so hungry I can't stand it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Oguri, are you okay? You<n>look rather
unsteady.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... It's just, no matter how<n>much I eat, I stay
starving.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I train real hard, then eat a lot... then<n>train real hard,
then eat a lot... It's like<n>a never-ending, inescapable
loop!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Why not take a break, then? You<n>won't be as
hungry if you have a<n>rest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know, but I just can't sit still.<n>Whenever I think of
the Arima Kinen I<n>lost, it feels like some invisible
force<n>is pushing me forward...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Argh, just while we've been talking,<n>the urge to
start exercising has gotten<n>unbearable!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Eat, run, eat!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even Oguri is at it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A part of me has grown complacent. I<n>thought I
could just spend every day<n>with you, leisurely
taking care of<n>everyone...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But it feels like a wall has formed<n>between me and
them... and I've<n>realized something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't look after them unless our<n>hearts are in
sync. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep moving forward with<n>you, Trainer! I
want to run alongside<n>the others in another race like
the<n>Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay! As long as I have everyone's<n>support and
you by my side, I won't<n>lose! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Super Creek smiles, the look on<n>her face
exudes the same warmth as<n>always.
